name: Flat-fee chargeback evidence packets with human review for tiny Shopify stores
buyer: Shopify, Stripe or PayPal merchants with a handful of disputes per month and no dedicated staff.
pain: Each dispute costs the merchant the sale plus a $15 fee on US Shopify Payments, which is returned only if the merchant wins. Shopify Protect covers fraud chargebacks on eligible Shop Pay orders, but non-fraud disputes and building the evidence are left to the merchant. Chargeflow users complain about not being able to review evidence before submission and an uncapped 25% fee.
wedge: A flat $9/month packet builder with a mandatory human-review step before the merchant submits. It targets merchants who dislike uncapped success fees and automatic submission with no review. Price and review control are the only differences, not a new capability.

scan1Edge.entrant_basis: The nearest flat-fee competitor is $19.99/month from the research notes, and the entrant would charge $9/month (ESTIMATE). That saves about $11/month, a minor edge. Versus 25% of $1,000 recovered ($250) the gap is larger, but a flat-fee rival already exists.
scan1Edge.falsifier: If merchants do not value review control or $11/month savings, or a flat-fee competitor drops its price, there is no edge.

unitEconomicsNoted.notes: Modelled: flat $9/month at about 85% margin. Not sourced. Support effort for evidence disputes is not included.

majorUncertainty: Whether merchants will trust an unknown tool with payment and customer data when established vendors already offer flat-fee and success-fee models.
unknowns: No evidence found of how many tiny merchants pay for chargeback help, versus handling disputes themselves.
Whether Shopify app review can be passed by an anonymous solo entrant, and the timeline.
Whether a manual-review model works at $9/month once support effort is counted.
ChargePay's name and price are only in the notes and in the C52 excerpt without the name.
Win rates for evidence packets built by the entrant are unknown.
regulatoryOrPlatformDependency: Needs Shopify, Stripe and PayPal API access and app review (about 30-60 days is an estimate). Win rates depend on card-network rules and deadlines, so outcomes cannot be promised. The tool would handle customer and payment data, so trust is hard for an unknown entrant.
